name: Daisy Cubes Are Partial Cubes
statement: Every daisy cube is a partial cube.
proof: A down-set induces an isometric subgraph of its Boolean cube: if $A$ and $B$ lie in the down-set, first delete the elements of $A\setminus B$ and then add the elements of $B\setminus A$ through subsets of $B$. This gives a path of length $|A\mathbin\triangle B|$, equal to their Hamming distance.
